immutability_rule: A captured raw file is never overwritten. This script refuses a target that already exists.
source_description: NCAA official scoreboard feed at data.ncaa.com/casablanca, the feed behind the NCAA's published scoreboard. Final scores, participants, scheduled start instants and NCAA game identifiers, published by the NCAA for its own site.
storage_rule: Responses are stored gzip-wrapped with mtime=0. raw_sha256 is the digest of the decompressed response body and is the digest custody is asserted over; stored_sha256 is the digest of the container git holds. .json.gz is byte-preserved by .gitattributes; .json is not.
